PART 1 — OVERALL STRUCTURE AND POSES (CRITICAL: EXACTLY FOUR PANELS ONLY): A photorealistic character reference sheet presented as EXACTLY FOUR vertical panels arranged horizontally side by side in a single wide 4:3 image — FOUR PANELS AND ONLY FOUR PANELS, no fifth panel, no 3/4 back view, no additional angles, no extra columns. The panel widths are NOT rigidly equal — each panel's width is naturally determined by its content: the first face close-up panel may be wider, the three full-body panels may be narrower, with organic flexible spacing between columns, thin clean dividing lines separating the panels. The entire sheet is set against a pure seamless light-grey studio background with no props, no furniture, no distractions. Panel one (far left): a close-up facial portrait, head and shoulders only, front-facing, the face filling the panel. Panel two (second from left): a COMPLETE full-body front-facing standing pose, the entire figure visible from the top of the head to the soles of the feet including shoes, the character standing upright and relaxed, both arms hanging naturally at her sides, feet together. Panel three (third from left): a COMPLETE full-body right-side 90-degree profile standing pose, the entire figure visible from head to toe including shoes, the character turned completely to her right showing the right profile of the face and the full right-side silhouette, one foot slightly forward. Panel four (far right): a COMPLETE full-body back-facing standing pose, the entire figure visible from head to toe including shoes, the character turned completely around showing the back of the head, back, and rear view of legs and shoes. THERE IS NO PANEL FIVE — do not generate a 3/4 view, do not generate a back-three-quarter view, do not add any additional angle or column. All three full-body panels (panels two, three, and four) must show the ENTIRE body from head to toe with no cropping at the waist, thighs, or ankles — the feet and shoes must be fully visible in every full-body panel. The same identical character appears in all four panels with perfectly consistent facial features, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, and height across every panel. Soft even front studio lighting illuminates all four panels equally, a subtle soft contact shadow under the feet only, neutral-warm color temperature. PART 2 — CHARACTER APPEARANCE: The character is a beautiful 22-year-old Chinese woman in a xianxia immortal style, gentle and ethereal with a calm composed expression. Facial features: soft oval face with warm fair porcelain skin and natural refined texture, full and smooth forehead fully exposed, natural willow-leaf eyebrows softly arched, bright peach-blossom eyes with softly upturned outer corners and deep brown pupils, straight slender qiong bi nose with a softly rounded tip, M-shaped cupid's bow lips of medium thickness in natural peachy-pink, small refined ears with plump earlobes. Hairstyle: lustrous jet-black half-up immortal bun with the rest cascading in soft waves past her waist, adorned with a white jade hairpin and a pearl hair ornament, a few face-framing tendrils, long silk ribbons in pale lavender trailing down. Body: approximately 168cm tall, slender willowy figure with a narrow waist and graceful long neck. Outfit (identical in all views): a layered xianxia hanfu — an outer robe of sheer white and pale lavender silk gauze embroidered with silver cloud and crane patterns, an inner skirt in soft misty blue reaching the ground, wide flowing sleeves, a jade belt at the waist with long tassels, white silk shoes. No jewelry except the hair ornaments. Quality safeguards: EXACTLY FOUR PANELS ONLY — no fifth panel, no 3/4 view, no extra columns, panel widths naturally adaptive not rigidly equal, no text, no watermark, no logo, the same identical character in all four panels, all full-body panels show head-to-toe complete figure with feet and shoes fully visible, no cropping, four clearly separated panels, anatomically correct proportions, natural skin texture, no extra limbs, no distorted hands, the side view a true 90-degree profile, the back view a true rear view, no artifacts.
